summary: Read two strings s and t that use only lowercase English letters. The longer string t may contain about 500000 characters, while s contains at most 100. Decide whether s can be obtained by deleting zero or more characters from t while keeping the surviving characters in their original order. Write true if that is possible, and write false if it is not.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
